text.en: Mitochondria are just the 'powerhouse of the cell' and have no other role -- in reality, mitochondria also participate directly in cell signaling and calcium buffering, and trigger apoptosis (programmed cell death) by releasing cytochrome c when a cell is damaged beyond repair; reducing them to only an energy-production role misses why cells dedicate an entire organelle, with its own DNA, to that broader signaling function.
text.et: Mitokondrid on lihtsalt 'raku elektrijaam' ning neil pole muid rolle -- tegelikult osalevad mitokondrid otse ka rakusignalisatsioonis ja kaltsiumi puhverdamises ning käivitavad apoptoosi (programmeeritud rakusurma), vabastades tsütokroom c-d, kui rakk on parandamatult kahjustatud; nende taandamine ainult energiatootmise rolliks jätab tähelepanuta, miks rakud pühendavad terve organelli, koos oma DNA-ga, sellele laiemale signaalfunktsioonile.
